§6Purpose and mechanism§r
The Gear Steam Compressor converts regular steam into superheated steam and a small amount of distilled water. Its output is only a fraction of the steam it consumes, so use it to cover a limited shortfall rather than as a net steam source. Its rate depends on tier; consult the controller tooltip for details.

§3Preparation and operation§r
The compressor supplements steam grade using existing supply infrastructure; it does not replace a boiler. Plan separate ordinary-steam input, superheated-steam output, and distilled-water byproduct paths so a blocked byproduct does not obstruct conversion. Match the selected tier to demand. When supply falls short, check production and the input route before upgrading.
